title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and improve cache hygiene
author: Evan Zhang
description: Motivation: our repository has accumulated multiple ad-hoc GH Actions workflows for lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation. This PR unifies the lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of well-documented, reusable workflows to reduce duplication, speed up CI iteration, and improve cache hygiene (cache keys and retention) to lower flaky cache misses. Changes include: consolidated lint and test matrices into shared templates; extracted job-level steps into composite actions where appropriate; normalized cache keys for node_modules, pip, and docker buildx layers; reduced parallelism for flaky integration jobs and added deterministic ordering for e2e test setup; simplified release automation by delegating tagging and changelog generation to a single release workflow; updated docs/CONTRIBUTING.md with CI runbook and troubleshooting steps. This description is a continuous summary of intent, scope, and follow-ups. Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and removed duplicate files - [x] Verified matrix permutations across python/ts/go SDKs - [x] Added cache key tests and validated miss/hit ratios on staging - [x] Added runbook section for rolling back workflow changes - [x] Added targeted test retries for known flakiness Related: ENG-2141 (CI consolidation), ENG-3300 (cache hygiene), SUP-9081 (customer incident linked to flaky tests).
commit_summary: chore(ci): introduce unified workflows and templates; refactor(ci): extract composite actions for lint and test steps; perf(ci): normalize cache keys and window retention; fix(tests): reduce parallelism on integration suite to avoid resource contention; docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md with CI runbook
review_comments: Aisha: requested splitting the large matrix for faster prioritization and suggested reducing default matrix permutations; Miguel: flagged two flaky e2e steps and asked to add targeted retries and a deterministic DB reset; Hannah: asked for stronger cache key semantics and a follow-up to validate cache hit rates on infra; Author responses: implemented reduced matrices, added retry wrapper for flaky steps, added cache validation script and ran two experimental CI runs on staging which show ~85% cache hit improvement for node/pip layers. After two rounds of cleanup and permission fixes to composite actions, reviewers approved.
release_notes: - Consolidated CI workflows: reduced number of GH Actions files and standardized templates. - Improved cache hygiene: more deterministic keys and retention, reducing cold-cache runs. - Reduced CI runtime for common push events by trimming matrix permutations. - Added CI runbook and troubleshooting steps to CONTRIBUTING.md.
